title: EEP Gate 403 Forbidden Response
description: Returned when a credential, agreement, identity, or allowlist gate prevents access Served as `application/problem+json` per RFC 9457; the EEP-specific members below are problem extension members.

type.description: RFC 9457 problem type URI identifying what went wrong. Dereferencing it SHOULD yield human-readable documentation. Clients match on this rather than on the HTTP status, which is why it is the stable identifier.

title.description: RFC 9457 short, human-readable summary of the problem type. MUST NOT change from occurrence to occurrence — vary `detail`, not `title`.

status.description: RFC 9457 HTTP status code, repeated in the body so the problem document survives being logged or forwarded away from its response.

detail.description: RFC 9457 human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence. Intended for a developer reading a log, not for an end user.

instance.description: RFC 9457 URI reference identifying this specific occurrence.

error.description: Fixed error code distinguishing from payment restriction (402)

resource.description: The resource path or pattern that was requested

current_tier.description: The tier the requesting agent currently holds

required_tier.description: The minimum tier needed to access the resource

unmet_requirements.description: List of specific requirements not satisfied

resolution_hint.description: Machine-readable instruction for how to satisfy this requirement

gates_config_url.description: URL to full gate configuration for the entity
